probability_checks.note: Retains the independent replay tolerance and tightens the previous author tolerance1e-10. No probability discrepancy is waived.
probability_checks.bce_note: Existing BCE tolerances retained. Independent BCE remains compared directly with canonical BCE.

threshold_band.interpretation: A fixed engineering resolution convention derived from float64 epsilon, chosen before confirmation. It is not a formal numerical error bound, a statistical confidence interval, or a new prediction threshold. It is narrower than the allowed probability verification tolerance.
threshold_band.disagreement_rule: Every independent versus canonical class disagreement must have BOTH probabilities within this band. Any disagreement outside the band remains FAIL. Record every disagreement with recordID, allocationdepth, label, both probabilities and both class decisions.
threshold_band.required_counts: Canonical near-band count, reference near-band count, union count, exact class agreement boolean, total disagreements and outside-band disagreements, by endpoint and relevant depth/route slices.
threshold_band.canonical_metric_rule: Exactly reconstruct confusion, macroF1 and accuracy from the saved production float probabilities at p>=0.5 and compare with recorded result/ledger/test report. Do not replace canonical probabilities or classifications with reference values.
threshold_band.reference_metric_rule: Retain raw independent matrix confusion, F1 and accuracy separately. Report their differences; do not claim exact classifier agreement when differences exist.

supplementary_sensitivity.mask: Canonical saved probability within the fixed inclusive band. This mask is label-independent. Reference-only and union near-band counts are separate diagnostics.
conventions: Assign every canonical band-ambiguous record to class0, holding all other canonical decisions fixed
Assign every canonical band-ambiguous record to class1, holding all other canonical decisions fixed
extrema: Label-assisted pessimistic assignment: classify every canonical band-ambiguous record incorrectly
Label-assisted optimistic assignment: classify every canonical band-ambiguous record correctly
supplementary_sensitivity.metrics: Confusion, macroF1 and accuracy only. No BCE is assigned to these hypothetical class vectors.
supplementary_sensitivity.limits: Conventions are not extrema. Pessimistic/optimistic values are numerical-sensitivity extrema for this explicitly defined ambiguity set, not attainable trained models or statistical uncertainty bounds. They use labels for diagnosis only, never for routing, training, selection or canonical prediction. Preserve all four cases; do not select a favorable convention.
